blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, BOHOL, Philippines — Two track and field athletes from Bohol won gold and bronze medals for the Philippines in the 18th Southeast Asian (SEA) U20 and U18 Athletics Championships in Pathum Thani, Thailand. Jhul Ian Cañalita captured the gold medal in the men’s 3,000-meter steeplechase U20 event, setting a new meet record of 9 minutes and 24.08 seconds. Meanwhile, fellow Boholano athlete Zyx Alexander Apalisoc won the bronze medal in the men’s 1,500-meter event. The championships are being held from Nov. 6 to 8 at the National Athletics Centre in Pathum Thani. Both athletes hail from Garcia Hernandez town […]...
